question: Which goalkeeper conceded just 4 goals across six 2013–14 Champions League knockout matches before losing the final in extra time?
hints: He was playing on loan in Madrid at the time.
His team stayed unbeaten until extra time in Lisbon.
He won the Zamora Trophy in La Liga that same season.
explanation: Thibaut Courtois conceded just 4 goals across six knockout ties against AC Milan, Barcelona, and Chelsea before Atlético lost 4–1 to Real Madrid in extra time.

question: Who scored the 11th and decisive spot-kick in Villarreal's 11–10 Europa League final shootout win over Manchester United in 2021?
hints: Every single outfield player on both sides had already scored.
He is an Argentine international goalkeeper.
Moments later, he saved David de Gea's penalty.
explanation: Goalkeeper Gerónimo Rulli lashed his penalty into the top corner and then saved David de Gea's effort to give Villarreal an 11–10 shootout victory in Gdańsk.

question: Who won the 2014–15 Premier League Golden Glove outright with 14 clean sheets?
hints: He won the award four times in five seasons.
His club finished second behind Chelsea that campaign.
He edged out Fraser Forster and Simon Mignolet (13 each).
explanation: Joe Hart kept 14 clean sheets in 2014–15 for Manchester City, beating Fraser Forster and Simon Mignolet by one to claim his fourth Golden Glove.

question: Who scored the fastest hat-trick in Premier League history (2 minutes 56 seconds) in May 2015?
hints: It happened against Aston Villa at St Mary's Stadium.
All three goals came between the 13th and 16th minutes.
He broke Robbie Fowler's 21-year-old record.
explanation: Playing for Southampton, Sadio Mané scored three goals in 2 minutes and 56 seconds against Aston Villa on 16 May 2015.

question: Which Welshman became the first player since Milan Baroš (2004) to score in all three group-stage matches at a European Championship in 2016?
hints: Two of his three group-stage goals came from direct free-kicks.
His team topped Group B ahead of England.
He scored against Slovakia, England, and Russia.
explanation: Gareth Bale scored in all three Group B matches (vs Slovakia, England, and Russia) as Wales reached the Euro 2016 semi-finals.

question: Which VfL Wolfsburg player won 2015 German Footballer of the Year after registering 21 Bundesliga assists in 2014–15?
hints: He helped Wolfsburg defeat Borussia Dortmund 3–1 in the DFB-Pokal final.
He left Germany for the Premier League in August 2015.
He is a Belgian playmaker.
explanation: Kevin De Bruyne registered 21 Bundesliga assists in 2014–15, winning German Footballer of the Year before joining Manchester City.

question: Which goalkeeper became the first Sevilla player in history to win the La Liga Zamora Trophy in 2021–22?
hints: He conceded just 24 goals in 31 La Liga appearances in 2021–22.
He previously played for Atlético Madrid B, Zaragoza, and Girona.
Months later, he kept clean sheets against Spain and Portugal at the 2022 World Cup.
explanation: Moroccan goalkeeper Yassine 'Bono' Bounou won the 2021–22 Zamora Trophy with a 0.77 goals-against average for Sevilla.

question: Which striker equalled Gonzalo Higuaín's all-time Serie A single-season scoring record of 36 goals in 2019–20?
hints: He also won the European Golden Shoe that season.
He scored 14 penalties during that 36-goal campaign.
He is Lazio's all-time leading goalscorer.
explanation: Lazio striker Ciro Immobile scored 36 Serie A goals in 2019–20, matching Gonzalo Higuaín's 2015–16 record and winning the European Golden Shoe.

question: Which Montpellier striker finished as Ligue 1 top scorer with 21 goals when Montpellier shockingly won the 2011–12 title?
hints: He tied on 21 goals with PSG's Nenê, winning the award via fewer penalties.
He moved to Arsenal that summer for around £9.6m.
He later became France's all-time leading men's goalscorer.
explanation: Olivier Giroud scored 21 Ligue 1 goals in 2011–12 to fire Montpellier to their first and only French top-flight title.

question: Which Tottenham player won both the Premier League Golden Boot (23 goals) and Playmaker Award (14 assists) in 2020–21?
hints: He formed a record-breaking partnership with Son Heung-min that season.
It was his third Premier League Golden Boot.
He moved to Bayern Munich in August 2023.
explanation: In 2020–21, Harry Kane topped both the Premier League goalscoring (23) and assist (14) charts — becoming the first player since Andy Cole (1993–94) to win both outright.

question: Which Tottenham winger scored a second-half hat-trick away at Ajax in May 2019 to send Spurs to the Champions League final?
hints: He was signed from Paris Saint-Germain in January 2018.
His winning goal arrived in the 96th minute.
L'Équipe awarded him a rare 10/10 match rating.
explanation: Lucas Moura scored in the 55th, 59th, and 90+6th minutes in Amsterdam to overturn a 3–0 aggregate deficit on away goals.

question: Which goalkeeper was famously subbed on specifically for the penalty shootout in the 2014 World Cup quarter-final vs Costa Rica?
hints: Louis van Gaal brought him on in the 121st minute.
He played his club football for Newcastle United at the time.
He saved penalties from Bryan Ruiz and Michael Umaña.
explanation: Louis van Gaal substituted Jasper Cillessen for Tim Krul in the 121st minute, and Krul saved two spot-kicks to send the Netherlands into the semi-finals.

question: Which Stuttgart striker broke the Bundesliga record for goals in the opening 8 matchdays of a season (14 goals) in 2023–24?
hints: A Guinea international striker who finished runner-up to Harry Kane with 28 league goals.
Joined Borussia Dortmund in the summer of 2024.
Previously played for Stade Rennais.
explanation: Serhou Guirassy netted 14 goals in Stuttgart's first 8 Bundesliga matches of 2023–24, surpassing Robert Lewandowski's previous mark of 13.

question: Who scored Chelsea's 83rd-minute equaliser in the 'Battle of the Bridge' (Chelsea 2–2 Tottenham) to mathematically hand Leicester City the 2015–16 title?
hints: He came off the bench at half-time.
He played a one-two with Diego Costa before curling into the top-right corner.
He won PFA Player of the Year the previous season.
explanation: Eden Hazard curled home an 83rd-minute equaliser against Tottenham on 2 May 2016 to mathematically confirm Leicester City as Premier League champions.

question: Which Atlético Madrid defender scored the title-winning header at Camp Nou against Barcelona on the final day of 2013–14?
hints: He rose highest from a Gabi corner in the 49th minute.
A Uruguayan international centre-back.
Five days later, he also opened the scoring in the Champions League final.
explanation: Diego Godín powered home a 49th-minute header at Camp Nou to secure the 1–1 draw that gave Atlético Madrid their first La Liga title since 1996.

question: Which Sampdoria veteran equalled Gabriel Batistuta's long-standing record of scoring in 11 consecutive Serie A appearances in 2018–19?
hints: He won the Serie A Capocannoniere award that season with 26 goals at age 36.
He previously played for Udinese, Napoli, Juventus, and Torino.
Known for scoring spectacular long-range volleys.
explanation: At age 36, Sampdoria captain Fabio Quagliarella scored in 11 straight Serie A matches in 2018–19 and finished top scorer ahead of Zapata and Ronaldo.

question: Who scored Borussia Dortmund's 93rd-minute aggregate winner against Málaga in the 2012–13 Champions League quarter-final?
hints: Dortmund scored twice in stoppage time to win 3–2 on the night.
A Brazilian centre-back who rarely started ahead of Hummels and Subotić.
He later crossed the Ruhr divide to join Schalke 04.
explanation: Brazilian defender Felipe Santana bundled in the dramatic 90+3rd-minute winner as Dortmund stunned Málaga 3–2 in April 2013.

question: Which midfielder won the FIFA World Cup Best Young Player Award at Brazil 2014?
hints: He beat out compatriot Raphaël Varane and Memphis Depay.
He scored his nation's opening goal in their Round of 16 win over Nigeria.
He was playing his club football at Juventus at the time.
explanation: Juventus midfielder Paul Pogba won the 2014 World Cup Best Young Player award after helping France reach the quarter-finals.

question: Who became the first Newcastle United player since Alan Shearer to score four goals in a Premier League match, doing so against Norwich in October 2015?
hints: He was a Dutch midfielder playing his debut Premier League season.
Newcastle won the match 6–2 at St James' Park.
He moved to Liverpool the following summer.
explanation: Georginio Wijnaldum netted four times in Newcastle United's 6–2 victory over Norwich City in October 2015.

question: Who scored Bayer Leverkusen's only goal in their 2023–24 DFB-Pokal final win over Kaiserslautern to complete an unbeaten domestic double?
hints: It was a curling 25-yard strike into the top corner.
He arrived from Arsenal in the summer of 2023.
He started almost every match of that historic unbeaten Bundesliga campaign.
explanation: Granit Xhaka struck a 16th-minute thunderbolt in Berlin as 10-man Bayer Leverkusen beat Kaiserslautern 1–0 to seal an invincible domestic double.

question: Which Costa Rica captain led his country to the 2014 World Cup quarter-finals and scored against both Italy and Greece?
hints: A left-footed attacking midfielder who played for Twente, Fulham, and Sporting CP.
His header beat Gianluigi Buffon in Recife.
He appeared in three World Cups (2014, 2018, 2022).
explanation: Bryan Ruiz headed the winner against Italy in Group D and netted against Greece in the Round of 16 as Costa Rica shocked the 2014 World Cup.

question: Which Napoli centre-back scored a 90th-minute header at Juventus in April 2018 to cut the title gap to one point?
hints: He towered above Medhi Benatia from a José Callejón corner.
Napoli won 1–0 in Turin.
He later captained Senegal to the 2021 Africa Cup of Nations title.
explanation: Kalidou Koulibaly's 90th-minute header gave Napoli a 1–0 victory in Turin in April 2018, setting up a dramatic final-month Scudetto race.

question: Which veteran striker scored 16 Ligue 1 goals at age 35 to lead Lille OSC to their shock 2020–21 French title?
hints: He joined Lille on a free transfer from Beşiktaş in 2020.
He scored twice in a pivotal 3–2 comeback win away at Lyon.
He was Turkey's long-serving national team captain.
explanation: At 35 years old, Burak Yılmaz scored 16 Ligue 1 goals in 28 appearances to spearhead Lille's 2020–21 French title win ahead of PSG.

question: Who scored a hat-trick of headers in just 13 minutes for West Bromwich Albion against Swansea City in December 2016?
hints: A Venezuelan international striker.
All three headers were assisted from wide crosses in the second half.
He became only the second player in Premier League history to score three headers in one game.
explanation: Salomón Rondón scored three headers in 13 minutes for West Bromwich Albion against Swansea City in December 2016, matching Duncan Ferguson (1997).

question: Who scored his first-ever UEFA Champions League goal in the 2021 final in Porto?
hints: Mason Mount provided the through-ball assist.
He rounded Ederson in the 42nd minute to score.
He had joined his club from Bayer Leverkusen the previous summer.
explanation: Kai Havertz broke his Champions League scoring duck on the biggest stage, rounding Ederson in the 42nd minute as Chelsea beat Man City 1–0.

question: Which veteran defender captained Villarreal throughout the 2021 UEFA Europa League final win over Manchester United?
hints: A 2010 World Cup winner with Spain.
He spent six seasons at Napoli before returning to La Liga in 2019.
He played all 120 minutes and converted his penalty in the Gdańsk shootout.
explanation: Centre-back Raúl Albiol captained Villarreal throughout the 2021 final against Manchester United, winning the club's first major European trophy.

question: Which Austrian defender celebrated Real Madrid's 2022 Champions League comeback over PSG by hoisting a white plastic chair above his head?
hints: He joined Real Madrid on a free transfer in 2021.
He won 10 Bundesliga titles in Germany.
He inherited Sergio Ramos's #4 shirt.
explanation: After winning 10 Bundesliga crowns at Bayern Munich, David Alaba went viral for celebrating Real Madrid's 2022 comeback over PSG with a pitchside folding chair.

question: Which Madrid-born right-back chipped a Panenka penalty to eliminate Spain in the 2022 World Cup Round of 16 shootout?
hints: He came through Real Madrid's youth academy.
He won the 2020–21 Serie A title with Inter Milan.
He later won consecutive Ligue 1 titles with PSG.
explanation: Born in Madrid, Achraf Hakimi coolly converted a Panenka penalty past Unai Simón to send Morocco into the 2022 World Cup quarter-finals.

question: Which Liverpool goalkeeper scored a 95th-minute headed winner at West Bromwich Albion in May 2021?
hints: He became the first goalkeeper in Liverpool history to score a competitive goal.
Trent Alexander-Arnold swung in the corner kick.
The win proved decisive in qualifying for the 2021–22 Champions League.
explanation: Alisson Becker glanced home Trent Alexander-Arnold's 95th-minute corner on 16 May 2021 to secure a crucial 2–1 win at The Hawthorns.

question: Which striker won the UEFA Europa League with both Chelsea (2013) and Atlético Madrid (2018)?
hints: He scored the opening goal in the 2013 final in Amsterdam.
He came on as a late substitute in the 2018 final in Lyon against Marseille.
He also won the Golden Boot at Euro 2012.
explanation: Fernando Torres scored in Chelsea's 2–1 win over Benfica in the 2013 Europa League final and lifted the same trophy with his boyhood club Atlético Madrid in 2018.
